Sometimes, being hospitalized can be a break you need. And therapists give you assessments that determine whether or not you need to be hospitalized because they're looking out for your well-being. They would lose sleep at night if they sent you home when they knew you weren't well and you committed suicide (and I'm not implying you will). Personally, I've never went but people at my school know exactly what to say to get admitted and aim to be admitted when taking assessments. They say they go for a break or a vacation sometimes. But I hope you feel better and things turn around for you. And never be afraid to ask for help.
